description: Find GlanceDesk calculators and compliance checks by topic, for example "UAE gratuity", "Pakistan salary tax", "loan EMI", "e-invoicing Saudi", "crypto liquidation price", "concrete mix cement bags". Returns each tool's slug, title, one-line description, page URL and which tool runs it.

product.description: calculators = GlanceDesk Calculators (money, tax, loans, conversions); jurisdiction = GlanceDesk Jurisdiction (compliance, labour law); crypto = GlanceDesk Crypto (futures, spot, staking, fees, crypto units; user-typed prices, not investment advice); compute = GlanceDesk Compute (engineering estimates for civil, electrical, mechanical and HVAC work; not a design check). Default any.

query.description: Words describing what the person wants to work out. Empty lists every tool.

name: search_tools
title: Search GlanceDesk tools
